Game Overview

Sum Forest Adventure puts players into a math experience centered on navigate the mystical Sum Forest, where clever calculations unlock enchanting paths. Strategize by combining numbers to reach targets without exceeding them. Beware, mistakes cost lives! Strengthen your math prowess while immersed in a captivating landscape. Sum Forest Adventure is charming, educational, and endlessly fun!
